account_access_security.label: account_access_security
account_access_security.name: Account Access & Apple ID Security
account_access_security.description: Apple ID locked, forgotten password, 2FA verification codes not received, account hacking or takeover fears.
account_access_security.rationale: High risk because account lockouts prevent customer usage and deal with sensitive credentials and identity security.

billing_subscription_refund.label: billing_subscription_refund
billing_subscription_refund.name: Billing, Subscriptions & Refund Requests
billing_subscription_refund.description: Unexpected charges, subscription cancellations, refund disputes, App Store purchase issues, double billing.
billing_subscription_refund.rationale: High risk due to direct financial impact, payment disputes, and chargeback threats.

cancellation_churn_complaint.label: cancellation_churn_complaint
cancellation_churn_complaint.name: Severe Dissatisfaction, Churn & Legal Escalations
cancellation_churn_complaint.description: Customers threatening to cancel services, switch to competitors (e.g. Android/Samsung), legal or regulatory threats.
cancellation_churn_complaint.rationale: High risk because churn threats and hostile sentiment require senior human intervention and brand damage control.

os_update_battery_drain.label: os_update_battery_drain
os_update_battery_drain.name: OS Update, Battery Life & Overheating
os_update_battery_drain.description: Battery draining quickly, device heating up, issues immediately following an iOS/macOS update, performance throttling.
os_update_battery_drain.rationale: Medium risk because widespread post-update issues affect user experience but rarely involve account security or financial loss.

hardware_physical_damage.label: hardware_physical_damage
hardware_physical_damage.name: Hardware Malfunction & Physical Repair
hardware_physical_damage.description: Cracked screen, broken buttons, charging port failure, physical hardware defects, Genius Bar repair booking.
hardware_physical_damage.rationale: Medium risk because physical repairs require diagnostic check-ins and repair appointments.

connectivity_network_bluetooth.label: connectivity_network_bluetooth
connectivity_network_bluetooth.name: Connectivity, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth & Cellular
connectivity_network_bluetooth.description: Wi-Fi disconnecting, Bluetooth pairing failure (AirPods/CarPlay), cellular carrier signal drop, no service.
connectivity_network_bluetooth.rationale: Medium risk as it disrupts device functionality, often resolvable via network reset or troubleshooting steps.

how_to_feature_inquiry.label: how_to_feature_inquiry
how_to_feature_inquiry.name: How-To Guides & Settings Guidance
how_to_feature_inquiry.description: Questions on how to configure settings, transfer data, use native features (Photos, iCloud backup, gestures).
how_to_feature_inquiry.rationale: Low risk standard informational queries that can be safely automated with knowledge base links and instructions.

other_general_inquiry.label: other_general_inquiry
other_general_inquiry.name: Other General Inquiries
other_general_inquiry.description: General praise, miscellaneous feedback, or non-critical questions outside defined operational buckets.
other_general_inquiry.rationale: Low risk catch-all intent for non-urgent messages.
